Package com.example.invoicecsv.service

Class InvoiceCalculationService

java.lang.Object
com.example.invoicecsv.service.InvoiceCalculationService
public class InvoiceCalculationService extends Object
Calculates derived values for invoice rows without modifying the original CSV values.

The service keeps the raw values from the source CSV and stores calculated values in separate fields. Money is represented using BigDecimal, which avoids floating-point precision issues.

    • calculate

      public InvoiceItem calculate(InvoiceCsvRow row)
      Calculates the derived amount and VAT amount for an input row.

      No rounding rule is imposed by the business requirements, so this service preserves the exact decimal arithmetic implied by the input values. If a project-specific rounding strategy becomes necessary later, callers can provide a custom MathContext when constructing this service.

      VAT values are accepted in either percent form or decimal form. For example, 10 and 0.10 both represent 10% for calculation purposes.

      Parameters:
      row - the parsed CSV row containing original source values
      Returns:
      a processed item with calculated values stored separately from the original values
